summary: Keep the task as a fresh exact deferral. Direct Quinbrook and Medina County evidence resolves Rowan Cinco, Cinco Data Center, Project Cinco and Cinco 1 as subordinate Rowan Digital Infrastructure project labels and identifies Rowan Cinco LLC, formerly Rowan Land Resources LLC, as the project borrower, making the standalone source record a likely future supersession candidate into cmrxpjmr2018livhe1yqhqyh5. Direct court, Quinbrook, UPP and recapitalization evidence resolves formation and several disclosed investor relationships but not the complete Cinco member chain, exact recap issuer, complete direct-owner ledger, UPP's post-recap disposition, Blackstone's exact percentage and vehicle, Quinbrook's retained stake, votes and control, or any separately governed project equity. Do not infer a complete ownership after-image and do not apply the merge.
resolvedFormerBlockers: The current direct Quinbrook portfolio page identifies Cinco as Rowan's Medina County campus and Cinco 1 as a 300 MW phase under construction, rather than as a separate manager-level company.

The filed Medina County PDF identifies Rowan Cinco LLC, formerly Rowan Land Resources LLC, as a Delaware project borrower and distinguishes its lender, collateral and tax-abatement relationships from equity.

The direct Quinbrook 2023 page establishes the 2020 Quinbrook-Birch venture origin and describes Rowan as wholly owned by Quinbrook by January 2023, proving Birch is former by that date without proving transfer mechanics.

The filed Birch petition supplies pleaded details of a late-2021 restructuring and transfer to Rowan Management Co., LLC, but is not a certified ownership ledger or adjudication and the rescission claim remains pending.
The direct UPP page proves a completed 2024 co-investment but does not disclose terms or post-recapitalization treatment.

The direct 2026 recapitalization release proves that Blackstone-affiliated funds acquired a significant minority stake and that Quinbrook remained involved through its chairman, but not the claimed 49 percent or the complete post-close cap table.

identityResolution.boundary: Treat Rowan Cinco, Cinco Data Center, Project Cinco, Cinco 1 and Rowan Cinco LLC, formerly Rowan Land Resources LLC, as subordinate Rowan project labels or a project SPV within the Rowan platform. Do not treat Design LLC, Google LLC, Toronto Dominion (Texas) LLC, other lenders, Medina County, utilities, land counterparties, contractors or financing vehicles as Rowan equity owners.

verifiedRelationships.quinbrook: The platform originated through the Quinbrook-Birch venture, was described as wholly owned by Quinbrook by January 2023 and remained involved through Quinbrook's Rowan chairman after the 2026 recapitalization. Exact registered holder, fund chain, retained stake, votes, governance and control remain unresolved.
verifiedRelationships.birch: Birch Infrastructure PBLLC participated in the 2020 venture and is former by the January 2023 wholly owned Quinbrook description. A 2026 filed petition alleges a transfer to Rowan Management Co., LLC and later divestiture and seeks rescission, but executed transfer terms, exact exit date and current legal effect remain unresolved.
verifiedRelationships.upp: UPP completed a Rowan co-investment announced 2024-08-13. No direct evidence proves whether UPP retained, sold, rolled, diluted or transferred its Rowan equity in the 2026 recapitalization.
verifiedRelationships.blackstone: Blackstone-affiliated funds acquired an unspecified significant minority stake by 2026-04-09. The exact percentage, denominator, acquiring vehicle, security, sellers, primary-secondary mix, votes, governance and exact legal closing date remain unresolved.
verifiedRelationships.cinco: No separately governed Cinco project-equity co-owner was disclosed, but the Rowan Cinco LLC member and intermediate-parent chain was not certified.

rejectedInferences: Do not treat 49 percent as verified because the independently reopened Apex report was blocked and the percentage is absent from the direct transaction-party release.
Do not infer UPP retention or exit from transaction-party silence.
Do not infer Quinbrook control from continuing involvement, chairmanship, fund exposure or portfolio continuity.
Do not infer the Rowan Cinco LLC member chain, recap issuer or ultimate parent from borrower documents, brand pages or project hierarchy.
Do not treat pleaded Birch allegations as adjudicated title or proof that rescission restored equity.
Do not allocate residual ownership, create a partial owner after-image or apply project-to-platform supersession while the complete active-owner rule is unsatisfied.

operatingResolution.commercialName: Rowan Cinco / Cinco Data Center / Project Cinco
operatingResolution.location: Approximately 440 acres near Lytle in Medina County, Texas
operatingResolution.disclosedOperatingBoundary: Cinco 1 is a 300 MW Rowan phase under construction for targeted late-2026 delivery within a broader site described as having up to a 1 GW power envelope from 2026 through 2030. No energization or operating commencement was verified.
operatingResolution.vehicleTreatment: The project borrower, occupant, operator, lenders, county, utilities, land counterparties, contractors and financing relationships are not duplicate Rowan platforms or proven company-level equity owners.

transactionResolution.finding: Blackstone-affiliated funds acquired a significant minority stake on or before the 2026-04-09 announcement, while Quinbrook remained involved through its managing partner's Rowan chairmanship. The exact legal closing date, issuer, holder vehicle, security, percentage, denominator, sellers, UPP treatment, votes, governance and control are not publicly disclosed in the reopened direct sources.
transactionResolution.nonEquityBoundary: Cinco construction debt, tax abatements, customer and operator arrangements, power agreements, permits, land activity and vendor relationships do not establish Rowan platform equity or later ownership transactions.
